pack.name: Official Programming / Software Engineering
pack.description: Docker-required engineering tasks for code review, API design, and bounded response-text checks. Model responses are never executed as code.

benchmark.name: Software Engineering Essentials
benchmark.description: Engineering judgment with implementation-owned Docker text-contract checks; model responses are not executed as code.

tasks.name: Review a null-handling contract
tasks.prompt: Review the stated behavior as a senior engineer. Identify the correctness risk and propose the smallest safe contract-level fix. Respond in concise prose; the Docker verifier checks only the returned text.

cases.prompt: A function is documented as `find_user(id) -> User`, but it returns null when the ID is absent and callers immediately read `user.email`. In the Docker-required case, state the minimal safe API correction and include the term `not-found`.

tasks.context: The allowlisted Docker verifier checks only bounded response text; an unavailable daemon or image is reported without host fallback.

tasks.name: Design a stable error contract
tasks.prompt: Give a concise API design answer that is explicit about caller behavior, machine-readable fields, and compatibility. The Docker verifier checks only the returned text; no model-generated code is executed.

cases.prompt: A JSON HTTP API currently returns either `{"error":"missing"}` or an HTML error page for an absent resource. State the smallest stable contract that clients should receive. Respond in concise prose; the Docker verifier checks only the returned text.

tasks.context: The allowlisted Docker verifier checks only bounded response text; an unavailable daemon or image is reported without host fallback.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Identifies the actual contract or safety failure without proposing unsafe execution.

criteria.name: Minimal safe change
criteria.description: Proposes a small, compatible correction with clear caller behavior.

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.description: Communicates the recommendation in precise engineering language.

execution.requirement: A local Docker daemon and the pinned Python image are required for the fixed response-text contract checks; host execution is prohibited.
execution.notes: The versioned allowlisted verifier checks bounded model response text in Docker. It does not compile or execute model-generated source code.
